title: 第17章 五首歌之约-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “你一个人来？”

    “没错，就是我一个人。”

    “小子，别给我吹牛逼。”

    宋柯不以为然。

    吹牛逼谁不会？

    别说一张专辑，就算是一首脍炙人口的歌曲，都不是那么容易创作出来。

    一个人包办一张专辑，不是没人做到，可质量如何保证？

    如果那么容易包办，那公司为什么还要费尽心思收歌？

    个人的力量永远无法比得过集体，这是不争的事实。

    “一个月，你给我一个月的时间，我拿出来5首歌。到时候由你来评判我够不够格！！”

    一个月五首歌，包含作词作曲。

    难度很大，但不至于没人完成。

    比如奶茶伦，当年吴宗宪跟他说只要拿出来50首歌就帮他出专辑。

    吴宗宪当然在开玩笑，但奶茶伦却当真了，真的在10天之后交出50首小样。

    这故事肯定有吹牛逼的成分。

    不过以奶茶伦当年的天赋，一天写两首歌没什么问题。

    在宋柯眼里，他不可能是下一个吴宗宪，魏沐也不可能是下一个奶茶伦。

    不过，他愿意赌一次。

    “好！！我答应你，如果你能拿出来让我满意的作品，到时候咱们再谈！！”

    老宋带着一肚子气走了，还有脸色惨白的小秘书。

    魏沐把他们送到车上，挥了挥手：“老宋，一个月之后再见，记得带上合同~~~”

    “开快点，再开快点！！”

    宋柯不断地催促司机，仿佛这样就能驱散回荡在他耳边的声音。

    “这路上限速，快不了。”

    出租车司机长得凶神恶煞，一副生人勿近的模样。

    他是一个地道的魔都人，最看不起这群装腔作势的京爷。

    有俩臭钱跟我装什么逼呢！！

    我沪爷会怕你京爷？

    你让我开快，我就不。

    宋柯懒得跟一个司机置气，只好闭目养神。

    过了十几分钟，小秘书见对方消了气，才轻声开口：“老板，咱们什么时候回京城？我好订票。”

    宋柯双手抱臂，没好气回道：“订今晚的机票。”

    他今年43岁，80年代在清华上学，90年代赴美留学，不到三十岁便创立了麦田音乐，是吃过见过的主。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You come alone?"

"That's right, it's just me."

“Boy, don’t brag to me.”

Song Ke disagreed.

Who can’t brag?

Let alone an album, even a popular song is not that easy to create.

​​It’s not like no one can do it by one person, but how can the quality be guaranteed?

If it’s so easy to arrange, then why does the company go to all the trouble to collect songs?

It is an indisputable fact that the power of an individual can never be greater than that of the collective.

"One month, you give me one month, I will come up with 5 songs. Then you will judge whether I am qualified or not!!"

Five songs a month, including lyrics and music.

It’s very difficult, but not impossible for anyone to complete.

For example, Milk Cha Lun, Wu Zongxian told him that he would help him release an album as long as he produced 50 songs.

Of course Wu Zongxian was joking, but Milk Tea Lun took it seriously and really handed over 50 demos after 10 days.

There is definitely an element of bragging in this story.

But with Milkcha Lun’s talent back then, writing two songs in one day was no problem.

In Song Ke’s eyes, he cannot be the next Wu Zongxian, and Wei Mu cannot be the next Milk Tea Lun.

However, he is willing to take a gamble.

"Okay!! I promise you, if you can come up with a work that satisfies me, we will talk about it then!!"

Lao Song left full of anger, along with the pale-faced little secretary.

Wei Mu sent them to the car and waved: "Old Song, see you in a month, remember to bring the contract~~~"

“Drive faster, drive faster!!”

Song Ke kept urging the driver, as if this could dispel the sound echoing in his ears.

"There is a speed limit on this road, so you can't go any faster."

The taxi driver looked fierce and looked like he would avoid strangers.

He is a true man from the capital, and he looks down on these pretentious Jingye the most.

Why are you pretending to be with me when you have two stinky rich people?!

​​ Will my Master Shanghai be afraid of your Master Jing?

You ask me to drive faster, but I won’t.

Song Ke was too lazy to vent his anger with a driver, so he had to close his eyes and rest.

After more than ten minutes, the little secretary saw that the other party had calmed down, and then spoke softly: "Boss, when are we going back to the capital? I can book a ticket."

Song Ke crossed his arms and replied angrily: "Book a flight for tonight."

He is 43 years old. He studied at Tsinghua University in the 1980s and went to the United States to study in the 1990s. He founded Maitian Music when he was less than 30 years old.
